Thirty years of Swedish first births against housing regime -- Wall 1's chain with register-grade data. Second-read packet.

GRANDPARENTAL CHILDCARE and SECOND BIRTH in China, dynamic model plus empirics. C.2.a's exposure with a parity-specific fertility outcome -- the closest boundary case in the batch, and one of at least three near-identical China second-birth childcare papers in this frame.

LEAVING THE PARENTAL HOME in the Czech Republic, Poland and the former GDR for women born 1952-1982. Post-socialist cohorts spanning the transition -- a setting where the arrangement changed sharply for reasons outside the individual.

'The Influence of KIN PROXIMITY on the REPRODUCTIVE SUCCESS of American Couples, 1900-1910' in Demography: kin availability against couples' birth spacing and child survival, using full-count historical census data. Only the second record in the proximity cell, and by far the largest -- and it separates spacing from survival, which the extended arm's evolutionary literature usually conflates.
Age at menarche in Polish girls. A.21's, deprecated.
Family-related life-course transitions in young adulthood against obesity, German KiGGS cohort.
Houses and HOUSEHOLD FORMATION in Pharaonic Egypt. Archaeological; the deepest historical instance of the construct in the frame.

No abstract; preprint of the preceding record, China. Duplicate pair.

THE EXTENDED ARM'S SECOND IDENTIFIED RECORD, and it names the problem explicitly: 'INTERGENERATIONAL LIVING ARRANGEMENTS AND MARITAL FERTILITY IN JAPAN: A COUNTERFACTUAL APPROACH', investigating CAUSAL links using the 2010 and 2015 Japanese National Fertility Surveys, and reporting that co-residence with the husband's parents is positively associated with completed marital fertility in the unadjusted comparison. A counterfactual framework applied to exactly this chapter's estimand. Priority read -- with the Taiwanese endogenous-coresidence paper it forms the extended arm's identified core.
No abstract; parental leave benefits in radiology residencies.
Intra-household inequality in reconstituted couple households.
Women's status and intimate partner violence in Tanzania; disruption of PATRILOCAL residence appears among the urbanisation changes described.

Intentions for a second child among Chinese one-child women after the universal two-child policy. Chinese second-child intention studies routinely carry co-residence and grandparental care as regressors; trace.

HOUSEHOLD FORMATION in SOUTH AFRICA, its disruption under apartheid and its changes since, using national micro-data 1995-2018. A setting where household formation was directly constrained by law -- a design-6 candidate the scope did not enumerate.
